title: Organizational chart of the Technological Capabilities Panel (1954), Chapter 1 p. 28
description: Boxed organizational chart titled "Technological Capabilities Panel," headed by "The President of the United States" with a dotted link to the Director, Office of Defense Mobilization. Below sit the Steering Committee (J. R. Killian, Jr., Director), Executive and Administrative Staff, Military Advisory Committee, Projects 1, 2 and 3, a Communications Working Group, a Consultant for Technical Personnel, and Agency Contacts (CIA, DOD) with one name redacted.
